# Battalion Foot Soldier: "When this creature enters, you may search your library for any number
# of cards named Battalion Foot Soldier, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle."
# Fierce Empath's optional ETB tutor (SEARCH to hand, REVEAL, SHUFFLE; no SEARCH controller role,
# guide D12) with Alpine Houndmaster's NAME_EQ filter and "reveal them" (QUnbounded), and
# Chandra, Heart of Fire's "any number of" = CHOOSE with QUnbounded.
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=OptionalEffect(
        inner=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.SEARCH, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QUnbounded(),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.NAME_EQ, string_value='Battalion Foot Soldier'),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                    ),
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                }),
                A(Verb.REVEAL, {'controller': ControllerRef.YOU, 'count': QUnbounded()}),
                A(Verb.SHUFFLE, {'zone': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU)}),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you may search your library for any number of cards named Battalion Foot Soldier, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
